quote.author: Edmund Burke, Reflections on the Revolution in France, 1790

macro.title: What It Means For VWRA, Global Bonds, Gold And BTC

stories.headline: In 2019 Europe annulled its vacuum energy label and published no replacement
stories.dek: Dyson brought the case and the General Court struck down Regulation 665/2013 on 8 November 2018, retroactively. What survives is a floor — 500 motor hours, 900 watts, one per cent re-emission — and no number that compares one machine with another.

stories.headline: A dozen Easton X10 shafts cost more than a Hoyt Podium riser
stories.dek: US$499.99 against US$399.99 at the same shop on the same day — and the shafts are the consumable. Archery is a measurement problem with one unstable component, and the component is you.

stories.kicker: The Travel Desk · The Japan Rail Pass
stories.headline: The Japan Rail Pass site still sells the seven-day at ¥50,000
stories.dek: The 1 October revision landed on one channel only: ¥53,000 through a JR-designated agent abroad, ¥50,000 buying direct online. That is ¥3,000 an adult, and this desk has carried the question open for nine issues.

stories.headline: Israel sealed Hebron and displaced two thousand Palestinians before Tuesday’s election
stories.dek: Defence Minister Israel Katz says the displaced “will not be allowed to return” until the army finishes in the city; Hebron’s mayor Yousef al-Ja’bari counts 2,200 forced out, and Israelis vote for 120 Knesset seats on 27 October.

stories.headline: Singapore’s MAS reports core inflation at 2.0 per cent, electricity 8.7 dearer
stories.dek: The same table has private transport at 7.1 per cent. Residents surveyed for SMU’s inflation index in September expect 3.4 per cent over the coming year — some way above the number the Government printed on Friday.

stories.headline: Treasury proposes scrapping its ten-to-the-twenty-fifth test for AI investment bans
stories.dek: The 38-page notice, filed for public inspection at 8.45am on Friday and publishing Monday as 91 FR 67396, would forbid any American funding of “any SI system” in six countries. Comments close 7 December.

stories.headline: Grado opened pre-orders on Thursday for the US$295 Signature S150
stories.dek: The hand-assembled Brooklyn open-back runs a new 44mm paper-composite driver at 38 ohms and 220 grams, and undercuts the next Signature model by seventy per cent. Grado’s own store lists it as “Pre Order” and “Sold out” at once.

stories.headline: Toledano & Chan launched the b/1 Dazzle on Saturday at US$7,700
stories.dek: The New York micro-brand cut dazzle camouflage into Grade 5 titanium and kept the Sellita SW100 that already powers its US$6,300 standard b/1 — 188 plain-dial pieces, plus twelve diamond-set Double Dazzles at US$9,700.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · You Can See Everything
stories.headline: A24’s You Can See Everything holds second place with 31.8 million dollars
stories.dek: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s 174-minute film scores 98 per cent on 166 reviews and 97 on Metacritic from just 40 — while Warner Bros.’ Clayface opened above it on Friday with 10.4 million.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Melbourne Cohort
stories.headline: A Melbourne cohort ties two hours of social media at twelve to depression
stories.dek: The Melbourne Child to Adult Transition Study followed 1,195 Australian children from a mean age of nine to nearly nineteen. For girls at twelve and thirteen the risk difference is 10.8 per hundred — with a confidence interval running from 2.7 to 18.9.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The AI Credit Scare
stories.headline: Ten-year Treasury yields fell below five per cent; Brent hit 116.72 dollars
stories.dek: That was the steepest one-day fall since March 2023, on Meta’s results and widening AI credit spreads. By Friday Brent had settled 3.14 per cent higher at US$116.72 and yields were back up. The Fed meets on 27 and 28 October.

stories.headline: Eight weeks of lifting cut Pernambuco patients’ sleep-quality scores by 3.2 points
stories.dek: Twenty-five adults with severe sleep apnoea, mean age 54.6, published in Sleep and Breathing on 20 October — and the one validated measure of daytime sleepiness did not move at all.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Before The Year Turns
stories.headline: Studio Ghibli opens at Gardens by the Bay on 18 December
stories.dek: Twelve recreated worlds across 3,500 square metres, resident adult tickets S$39 and concessions S$29 — and Yokohama’s GREEN×EXPO prices twelve-to-seventeens at ¥3,000 against ¥4,900.

stories.kicker: Land Tenure · Papakāinga On Whenua Māori
stories.headline: New Zealand freed papakāinga from planning law and left the title problem untouched
stories.dek: Regulations in force since 2 July permit ten homes per site with no resource consent, overriding all 65 district plans. In Tauranga, one of the country’s fastest-growing cities, Māori land has yielded sixteen completed homes in five years.
